title: Every regular bipartite graph is 1-factorable
statement: Let $G$ be a bipartite graph with vertex classes $X$ and $Y$, and let $k$ be a positive integer. If $G$ is $k$-regular, then $G$ is $1$-factorable; that is, $G$ decomposes into edge-disjoint $1$-factors.
hypotheses_covered: G is bipartite with parts X and Y
